values.note: $35 a night for a water-and-electric site, $38 for the riverside sites (1-6, 9), $40 for full hookups (24-31). Plus a $2 daily parking pass ($3 boat launch). The park is cashless: card or mobile wallet only.

fees.source: https://www.rfpra.com/_files/ugd/367faf_2d0f8b17ebf74324b281c205ea32650b.pdf (site table: sites 7-8 and 10-23 '$35.00', 1-6 and 9 'On the Coosa River' '$38.00', 24-31 '$40.00'; 'General Fees - $2.00 daily parking pass $3.00 boat launch fee'); https://www.rfpra.com/lockanddam ('Starting August 1, 2022, the Lock and Dam Park will be cashless'), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: https://www.rfpra.com/_files/ugd/367faf_2d0f8b17ebf74324b281c205ea32650b.pdf ('All Sites (1-31) have picnic tables, power, water'; AMP column '30/50' at 28 sites, '30' at 25-27; 'Sites 24-31 are FULL HOOK UP SITES with sewer hook-up'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 31 RV sites (28-50 ft, so all take a 23-ft rig; site 12 is a narrow pull-through also used for tents); 7 pull-throughs (7, 8, 12, 25-27, 31); several sites have limited parking for a tow vehicle. Primitive camping for organized groups only.

sites.source: https://www.rfpra.com/_files/ugd/367faf_2d0f8b17ebf74324b281c205ea32650b.pdf ('RV Size' column 28-50; 'Pull Thru' site notes; 'Primitive Camping is available ONLY to organized groups'), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.rfpra.com/lockanddam ('restroom, shower and laundry facilities'; amenities 'Bath House'); park map ('Bath House' in the campground loop), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Online through Firefly Reservations, in the Coosa River Trading Post, or by phone (the rate sheet says reservations are required). Stays over 14 days need the Authority's approval. Check-in 2-4 PM, check-out 11 AM.

booking.source: https://www.rfpra.com/lockanddam ('Reservations can be made online, in the store or over the phone'; 'Online Reservations' -> https://app.fireflyreservations.com/Kiosk/Property/CoosaRiverCampground); rate sheet PDF ('Reservations are Required and must be made ONLINE'); Usage Rules PDF ('Any reservations over fourteen (14) days must be approved by Rome-Floyd County Parks & Recreation'; 'Check in time is between 2:00 p.m. and 4:00 p.m.'; 'Check out time for all campers is 11:00 a.m.'), read 2026-10-29

note: Rome-Floyd County Parks & Recreation Authority park (181 Lock & Dam Rd SW, Rome), a 73-acre park on the Coosa River at the historic lock and dam. Sites 1-6 and 9 line the river road behind a strip of trees. The Coosa River Trading Post handles registration and sells bait, tackle and licenses; boat ramp, fishing pier and trails. --Claude
summary: Rate sheet linked from the park page confirms $35 / $38 riverside / $40 full hookup (stored 35-40 confirmed) plus $2 daily parking; 31 RV sites (count added), all 30/50 A except 25-27 (30 A) so electric 50 added, sewer at 24-31, max 48 -> 50 ft, 7 pull-throughs; showers/laundry/flush toilets; booking set to operator (Firefly) with 14-night max. Season (year-round, from old note prose) left: no page states it. Pin sits at the store/campground (fine). Note trimmed of counts/hookups/length and reworded.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: stored riverview. The operator's rate sheet labels sites 1-6 and 9 'On the Coosa River' ($38). On imagery and the park map their road runs ~20-40 m from the riverbank with a band of trees between, so riverfront for that row is plausible but unconfirmed.
